description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's merge-recursive functionality, specifically focusing on merge detection, rename detection, thresholds, and other merge options. It contains setup commands, test cases, and functions to verify Git behavior with various rename detection configurations.

methods.name: get_expected_stages
methods.description: Sets up expected file stages for rename detection tests by checking out specific files and listing their staging information.

methods.name: rename_detected
methods.description: Verifies that the renaming was detected as expected by comparing actual and expected staging information.

methods.name: rename_undetected
methods.description: Verifies that renaming was not detected in specific cases, comparing actual and expected stages.

methods.name: check_common
methods.description: Checks the total number of staged files to verify the expected number of changes.

methods.name: check_threshold_0
methods.description: Checks the detection behavior at a low similarity threshold (0%).

methods.name: check_threshold_1
methods.description: Checks the detection behavior at a medium similarity threshold (50%).

methods.name: check_threshold_2
methods.description: Checks the detection behavior at a high similarity threshold (75%).

methods.name: check_exact_renames
methods.description: Verifies that only exact renames are detected (threshold 100%).

methods.name: check_no_renames
methods.description: Verifies that no renames are detected.
